subject: general
question: Which of the following teams was the winner of 2nd edition of Women's Premier League?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Royal Challengers Bangalore (Bengaluru)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Royal Challengers Bengaluru **(RCB) won the second season of the **Women's Premier League (WPL) in 2024.**
 
• The team **defeated Delhi Capitals in the final. **
 
• **Smriti Mandhana captains t**he RCB team.
 
• The matches were held in Bengaluru and Delhi.
 
• The **Board of Control for Cricket in India **(BCCI) organizes the league

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Women's Premier League**, also known as WPL, and the Tata WPL for sponsorship reasons, is a women's Twenty20 cricket franchise league in India.
 
• It is owned and **operated by the Board of Control for Cricket in India**
 
• The **first season, played in March 2023,** saw the Mumbai Indians winning the inaugural title
 
• The league's structure is based on the structure of the IPL
